I made both edits to `src/flask/cli.py` as written. In `run_command`, the line `debug = get_debug_flag()` is now `debug = _debug_from_env()`, and `_debug_from_env` is defined at the end of the file. The file still parses without errors. I didn't run the test suite.

One thing to be aware of: "the end of the file" is after the `if __name__ == "__main__": main()` block. If someone ran `cli.py` directly as a script, `main()` would start before `_debug_from_env` exists, so `flask run` would fail with a `NameError`. The usual ways of starting Flask (`python -m flask` or the `flask` command) aren't affected.

- `ScriptInfo.load_app` in `src/flask/cli.py` (line 355)

- `Flask.run` in `src/flask/app.py` (line 591)
- `App.make_config` in `src/flask/sansio/app.py` (line 495)

`run_command` no longer calls it directly; it goes through `_debug_from_env` now.
